payload.text: D1 (vc, docs, before the next cut): packaging/homebrew/ccusage.rb:56's caveat, 'macOS may request Keychain access once per account when moving to signed releases', contradicts README:112: since 0.1.6 ccusage has no Keychain access of its own, and only an item an older ccusage left without apple-tool: asks, once, to allow security. hv saw it at today's brew upgrade, and the next formula publish renders it.
